p: O LORD: He flees to God to be the judge of his just cause, seeing there is no equity among men.
reins and my heart: My very affections and inward motions of the heart.
lovingkindness is before mine eyes: He shows what stayed him, that he did not recompense evil for evil.
sat with vain persons: He declares that they cannot walk in simplicity before God, that delight in the company of the ungodly.
wash mine hands in innocency: I will serve you with a pure affection, and with the godly that sacrifice to you.
Gather not my soul with sinners: Destroy me not in the overthrow of the wicked.
mischief: Whose cruel hands execute the malicious devises of their hearts.
an even place: I am preserved from my enemies by the power of God, and therefore will praise him openly.
